scope: Official Python 3.12 semantics for timezone-aware ISO parsing and short-duration monotonic timing; no external implementation or asset intake.

sources.title: datetime - Basic date and time types
sources.used_principle: Preserve the existing datetime.fromisoformat-based aware timestamp semantics while avoiding duplicate parsing within one retrieval call.

sources.title: time - Time access and conversions
sources.used_principle: Use perf_counter_ns differences for high-resolution monotonic short-duration measurements without float precision loss.

sources.title: timeit - Measure execution time of small code snippets
sources.used_principle: Use repeated measurements and warmup for a bounded retriever-level comparison; do not infer whole-system dominance from a microbenchmark.

limitations: Official API semantics do not establish Runbook Sentinel performance or product utility.
The project-authored development microbenchmark is diagnostic and must remain separate from frozen whole-system evaluation.
Runbook Sentinel remains synthetic-only and research-informed.
